verdict.rationale: The evidence shows leaving is plausible. Trigger.dev is an open-source platform you can self-host with `docker compose up`. Tasks are plain TypeScript functions in your own codebase, not a proprietary DSL. Run data can be queried with SQL-style TRQL or reached through the management API. Missing for 10: any documented bulk export of run, log or schedule data, any stated open export formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet), a documented cloud-to-self-host migration path, and independent confirmation that users have exported and left.
